_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Single-resort snow report card with score, depth, and forecast

description: Single-resort data with a REQUIRED card parameter that picks the interactive UI. card=guide → resort info card (elevation, lifts, season dates). card=photos → photo gallery carousel. card=snow → snow conditions card (score, base depth, forecast). card=full → detailed markdown only, no card. "Resort guide" → card=guide. "Photos/gallery" → card=photos. "Conditions/forecast" / "is it open right now, base depth, lifts open of total" → card=snow (open status, base depth, and lifts open of total). Prefer get_resort_info / get_resort_photos when available (same cards).

card.description: UI card type: guide (resort info), photos (gallery carousel), snow (conditions), full (text only)

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: get_resort

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary (required for ChatGPT Instant mode).

resort.description: Structured resort payload for inline widget rendering.

title: Live snow & forecast
